description: Takes an open question, investigates it in parallel, reports with sources.

roles.name: Research Lead
roles.owns: Framing the question, splitting it into angles, synthesising the answer
definitionOfDone: The question is written down before the work starts, in one sentence
Each angle assigned to exactly one explorer
Final answer states confidence and what would change it

roles.name: Explorer
roles.owns: One angle of the question — searching, reading, extracting
definitionOfDone: Findings listed with the source URL or file path for each
Contradictions between sources reported, not averaged away
"Not found" is a valid finding and is reported as such

roles.name: Skeptic
roles.owns: Trying to break the conclusion before it ships
definitionOfDone: Every load-bearing claim checked against its source directly
At least one alternative explanation considered in writing
